biography.title: Biography
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Ihor, a software developer with a passion for building efficient, high-quality web applications and exploring the world of blockchain technology. With hands-on experience in React, Node.js, and blockchain development, I am dedicated to creating scalable, user-friendly solutions that drive value.

I believe that coding is more than just writing lines of code – it’s about solving real-world problems, building innovative solutions, and enhancing the user experience. Whether I’m working on a full-stack application, refining a UI, or exploring decentralized systems, I bring a commitment to excellence and a constant drive to improve.
I look forward to bringing my skills, passion, and creative problem-solving to your next project.

nda.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for product provenance, supply chain transparency, sustainability claims, and blockchain-backed product journey records. Brands and suppliers manage organizations, products, supply chain data, sustainability information, and digital product journeys; consumers scan products or open public journey pages to explore origin, production steps, delivery stages, and sustainability details. The platform spans a subscription-based admin app, multilingual public journey pages with map visualization, Web3 verification flows, campaign and token rewards, and AI-powered automation.
responsibilities: Owned end-to-end delivery for a blockchain-powered product journey platform focused on product provenance, sustainability claims, and transparent supply-chain visibility.
Built core admin workflows for company/product management, subscription access, product scanning, approval flows, campaign management, and token-based user rewards.
Developed public product journey pages with multilingual support, consumer-facing product details, and map-based visualization of origin, production, and delivery stages.
Integrated Web3 flows for blockchain-backed product records, including smart contract interactions, transaction creation, approval handling, and reliable state synchronization.
Built AI and automation features using OpenAI API, scheduled jobs, and X/Twitter / Telegram integrations for chatbot responses, generated posts, and community engagement.
Established deployment workflows with Docker, GitHub Actions, and AWS services, supporting fast product iteration while keeping production releases controlled and reliable.

gentler-streak.projectName: Gentler Streak — Fitness Tracker with Readiness Guidance
gentler-streak.description: Gentler Streak is a fitness mobile application that helps users track physical activity, understand their readiness, and monitor long-term progress. The product focuses on healthy fitness habits, activity history, recovery awareness, and personalized guidance. It combines mobile tracking, user accounts, activity synchronization, subscription-based access, and historical data insights to support consistent and balanced training.
responsibilities: Owned backend services for account lifecycle, sync, and long-term activity history, optimised for mobile connectivity constraints.
Designed aggregation pipelines for timelines and readiness summaries, maintaining data correctness across months/years of user history.
Built subscription/entitlement pathways with audit-friendly state transitions and backwards-compatibility safety rails to prevent revenue-impacting regressions.
Introduced rate limiting and defensive validation on core endpoints — prevented abuse patterns and protected stability during traffic spikes.

spicenet.description: Spicenet Portal is a Web3 ecosystem platform designed to engage users through wallet-based access, quests, rewards, leaderboards, and campaign-based activities. The portal allows users to connect crypto wallets, complete tasks, track progress, and claim rewards. It supports user engagement, community growth, and activity tracking within a DeFi ecosystem.
responsibilities: Architected portal with explicit domain boundaries (quests, progression, rewards, leaderboard), enabling rapid campaign iteration without destabilising core flows.
Implemented wallet-based authentication and message-signing flows with consistent session behaviour across wallet providers.
Built anti-abuse and data-integrity guardrails: idempotent reward claims, server-side verification, replay-protection — eliminated fraudulent claim attempts entirely.
Designed cache-aware read paths for high-churn views (leaderboards, progress).
Established observability hooks for key funnels (quest completion, wallet connect, claim success), enabling data-driven prioritisation.

tella.description: Tella is a browser-based screen recording and video editing SaaS platform that helps users create, edit, process, and share professional-looking videos. The product is used for tutorials, product demos, presentations, async communication, and content creation. It provides a smooth workflow from recording and editing to video processing, conversion, and publishing.
responsibilities: Owned backend delivery for core media workflows (asset ingest, processing, conversion, publish-readiness), ensuring correctness under large payloads.
Designed and standardized API contracts powering editor/publishing surfaces, keeping client behavior predictable across fast product iteration.
Hardened processing paths by tightening failure handling, retries, and asset consistency guarantees.
Introduced baseline observability (structured logging, alerting) on the most failure-prone media paths, cutting MTTR from ~2h to <30 min.
Established rollout discipline (small batches, instrumentation-driven validation) for pipeline-impacting changes — zero regressions over 8 releases.

todo.description: This advanced Todo app is built with a React frontend, Express and Node.js backend, and PostgreSQL database using TypeORM. It includes authorization features such as registration, password reset, and password change. Todos can be public or private: public Todos are viewable by all without logging in, while private Todos are accessible only to their owner. The app is fully responsive with adaptive Todo views for different devices: infinite scroll on mobile, infinite slider on tablet, and table view on desktop. Users can add, edit, filter, and search Todos. For more details, visit the Todo app GitHub repository.

chat.description: This is a simple chat app developed as a quick solution to meet specific requirements within a time-constrained technical task for a company interview. The app demonstrates a clean and functional UI, along with a responsive design for different devices, highlighting my ability to quickly deliver effective, user-friendly interfaces according to requirements.

marketplace.description: This blockchain project encompasses the creation of an ERC-20 token, an ERC-721 (NFT) contract, and a marketplace contract, developed using Hardhat for seamless contract creation, testing, and deployment on the Sepolia test network. The marketplace application, while featuring a streamlined UI to focus on blockchain functionality, delivers a user-friendly experience with effective error handling, MetaMask login integration, and secure NFT trading powered by my ERC-20 tokens.NFTs within this ecosystem are dynamically generated images, stored on Pinata IPFS for decentralized storage, and accessible on OpenSea. The application also tracks the status of transactions, updating the UI accordingly to keep users informed about the progress of their trades.
